# Xodus Nexus 0.3.6

- Add controller navigation across the launcher, including game selection, sidebar tabs, library filters, search and dialogs. Thanks @Techzilla44 for the suggestion.
- Fix doubled keyboard input in Steam Game Mode without changing game input settings.
- Search all pages of My Library automatically. Clear search text on restart while remembering Access and Play state filters.
- Open the selected game from Most recent and library search results.
- Preview download progress from Install Queue and show a desktop notification when an installation completes.
- Allow removing another game during downloads, while protecting active installation folders. Explain permanent file deletion and offer to keep the files.
- Ignore commented-out manifest examples when importing games.

Update the Nexus backend to **0.2.5** and install the new runtime in **Settings** for the accompanying game fixes.

## Steam Deck and similar handhelds

Steam Deck and similar handheld support is experimental. I'm currently testing and debugging on virtualized SteamOS, so I can't fully verify how everything behaves on real handheld hardware. Please report any issues you encounter.

I'm looking to buy an older Steam Deck or a similar handheld compatible with Bazzite or SteamOS for development and testing. If you have one you'd be willing to sell, please message me on Reddit at [u/Embarrassed-Hall-617](https://www.reddit.com/user/Embarrassed-Hall-617/). Cosmetic damage and signs of wear don't matter, as long as the device's basic functions work.
